histogram.name: Android.MemoryPressureNotification{AndroidProcessType}
histogram.summary: Memory pressure notifications sent by Android through ComponentCallbacks2. This metric is copied from android/histograms where it expired in 2021.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Android.ColdStart
histogram.summary: Records whether the application startup was a cold start (true) or a warm start (false). Recorded during activity initialization.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Features.NativeMemoryAblation.AllocatedMB
histogram.summary: Records the amount of native memory allocated in megabytes when the native memory ablation Finch feature is enabled.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Features.NativeMemoryAblation.Enabled
histogram.summary: Records whether the native memory ablation Finch feature is enabled. Used to verify experiment arm rollout for Finch validation.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Features.NativeMemoryAblation.Result
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of the native memory ablation allocation attempt.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Features.TestFinchFeature
histogram.summary: Records whether the test Finch feature is enabled. Used for validating feature deployment.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Features.TestFinchFeatureParam
histogram.summary: Records the hash of the parameter value for the test Finch feature. Used for validating parameter propagation.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Finch.ConfigAgeInDays
histogram.summary: Records the age of the Finch configuration in days each time it is checked at startup. This data is used to determine an appropriate expiration threshold.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Finch.ConfigOutcome
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of variations experiment configuration loading during startup.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Finch.ConfigState
histogram.summary: Records the state of the Finch configuration at startup. This is used to monitor the frequency of expired or invalid configurations.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Finch.CrashStreakAtStartup
histogram.summary: Records the variations crash streak number at startup. This helps track system stability and safe config activation.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Finch.HasInvalidFeatureType
histogram.summary: Records whether any features in the variations configuration had an invalid (non-boolean) type.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Finch.HasInvalidParamType
histogram.summary: Records whether any parameters in the variations configuration had an invalid (non-string) type.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Finch.NumFeaturesApplied
histogram.summary: Records the number of experiment features successfully registered and applied at startup.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Finch.NumParamsApplied
histogram.summary: Records the number of experiment parameters successfully registered and applied at startup.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Finch.SetExperimentState.ParseError
histogram.summary: Records when SetExperimentState fails because the variations config dictionary could not be parsed.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Finch.TimeBetweenWrites
histogram.summary: Records the duration since the last time the variations experiment configuration was written to persistent storage.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Finch.VersionComparisonIsValid
histogram.summary: Records whether the version strings in the Finch config are valid and can be parsed correctly. A false value indicates a malformed version string was received.

histogram.name: Cobalt.LoaderApp.ElfDecompressionDuration
histogram.summary: The time it takes for the ELF dynamic shared library, stored as an LZ4 compressed file, to be decompressed. This metric is only recorded when the shared library is stored as an LZ4 compressed file.

histogram.name: Cobalt.LoaderApp.ElfLoadDuration
histogram.summary: The time it takes for Cobalt's ELF Loader to load the dynamic shared library, which under normal operation is the Cobalt Core library. This metric is only recorded when the shared library is stored as a compressed file, and this metric includes decompression time.

histogram.name: Cobalt.LoaderApp.ElfLoadUnexplainedDuration
histogram.summary: Cobalt.LoaderApp.ElfLoadDuration minus Cobalt.LoaderApp.ElfDecompressionDuration. This metric is only recorded when the shared library is stored as an LZ4 compressed file.

histogram.name: Cobalt.LoaderApp.MaxSampledUsedCPUMemoryDuringELFLoad
histogram.summary: The maximum sampled value of CPU memory used by the Loader App while the ELF dynamic shared library is being loaded. Note that this maximum sampled value is not guaranteed to be the true maximum value, which could be greater. This metric is only recorded when the shared library is stored as a compressed file.

histogram.name: Cobalt.LoaderApp.SlotSelectionStatus
histogram.summary: Status of slot selection by the Loader App.

histogram.name: Cobalt.LocalStorage.DatabaseCommitError
histogram.summary: Records the leveldb error when a commit fails in Local Storage.

histogram.name: Cobalt.LocalStorage.DatabaseOpenError
histogram.summary: Records the leveldb error when opening the Local Storage database fails.

histogram.name: Cobalt.LocalStorage.DatabaseReadError
histogram.summary: Records the leveldb error when a read fails in Local Storage.

histogram.name: Cobalt.LocalStorage.DatabaseResetReason
histogram.summary: Records the reason why the Local Storage database was reset.

histogram.name: Cobalt.LocalStorage.DatabaseVersionMismatch
histogram.summary: Records the leveldb status when a version mismatch is detected in Local Storage.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Media.IsBufferPoolAllocateOnDemand
histogram.summary: Records whether the Starboard media buffer pool is allocated on demand as reported by SbMediaIsBufferPoolAllocateOnDemand(). Recorded during DecoderBufferAllocator initialization.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Network.CumulativePlatformErrorRaised
histogram.summary: Records the number of times a platform error was raised due to a navigation timeout or other network error. This is logged every time RaisePlatformError is called; each logged count is the cumulative number of times the error has been raised. The actual number of sessions with a specific number of platform errors raised can be raised by subtracting the values of counts larger than said number. For example, sessions with 2 calls to RaisePlatformError would be (count for 2 calls) - (count for 3 calls) - ... (count for max calls). This value is reset to 0 on a successful navigation/app load.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Network.NavigationTimeout
histogram.summary: Records whether a primary main frame navigation timed out before completion or failure. This is logged when the navigation timer fires.

histogram.name: Cobalt.PictureInPicture.Enter
histogram.summary: Records whether entering Picture-in-Picture succeeded (true) or failed (false). Emitted when attempting to transition to Picture-in-Picture mode.

histogram.name: Cobalt.PictureInPicture.Exit
histogram.summary: Records whether exiting Picture-in-Picture succeeded (true) or failed (false). Emitted when attempting to leave Picture-in-Picture mode.

histogram.name: Cobalt.SplashScreen.FetchedFromCache
histogram.summary: Records whether a splash screen resource was successfully retrieved from cache and indicates the reason when on error. This is recorded for every splash screen request handled by h5vcc scheme loader.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Stability.Android.SystemExitReason
histogram.summary: Reason given by Android ActivityManager for the exit of the previous Cobalt browser process, recorded on startup for Android R+ (API 30+) devices. Extracted from the previous session's persistent memory allocator file PID. Records Android API failed when ActivityManager does not return a reason.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StabilityMetrics.IsNearCapacity
histogram.summary: Records whether the Cobalt Persistent Memory Allocator (PMA) for stability metrics is full or within 90% of capacity. Recorded at key startup stages.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StabilityMetrics.PercentFull
histogram.summary: The percentage of capacity currently used in the Cobalt Persistent Memory Allocator (PMA) for stability metrics (BrowserStabilityMetrics). Recorded at key startup stages.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StabilityMetrics.UsedKilobytes
histogram.summary: The number of kilobytes currently used in the Cobalt Persistent Memory Allocator (PMA) for stability metrics (BrowserStabilityMetrics). Recorded at key startup stages.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Startup.MilestoneReached
histogram.summary: Records startup milestone markers reached during browser initialization and initial navigation.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Startup.Time.NavigationDispatchToCommit
histogram.summary: Measures the duration from DidStartNavigation to DidFinishNavigation (commit) for the initial startup navigation in the primary main frame.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Storage.Cookie.CommitDurationPerOperation
histogram.summary: Measures the average time spent per cookie operation during a batch commit to the SQLite database. This provides a normalized view of commit performance, helping to identify how efficiently the database handles operations as the batch size changes.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Storage.Cookie.LoadDuration
histogram.summary: Records the total time it takes to load all cookies from the SQLite database into memory when the application starts and makes its first network request. This helps us understand the performance impact of cookie loading on startup.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Storage.Cookie.PendingOperationsAtCommit
histogram.summary: Records the number of pending cookie operations (add, update, delete) that are being committed to the database in a single batch. This gives an indication of the amount of data at risk of loss if a crash occurs between commits (the "crash gap").

histogram.name: Cobalt.Storage.Exit.CookieFlushDuration
histogram.summary: Records the time it takes to flush cookies during a graceful application exit (e.g., via window.h5vcc.system.exit()). This helps to understand the performance of the operation and can serve as a health signal for the storage backend.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Storage.Exit.LocalStorageFlushSchedulingDuration
histogram.summary: Records the time it takes to initiate the flush of local storage during a graceful application exit (e.g., via window.h5vcc.system.exit()). As `Flush()` is an asynchronous operation, this metric captures the time until the commit is scheduled, not the completion of the data write to persistent storage.

histogram.name: Cobalt.Storage.OnPause.FlushDuration
histogram.summary: Records the time it takes to flush both cookies and local storage during the onPause event on Android. This helps to understand if the operation completes within the short window granted by the OS before the app is killed.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StorageMigration.CookieInjectionResult
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of attempting to inject a single cookie into the new Chromium-based storage during migration from legacy Starboard storage.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StorageMigration.CookiesCount
histogram.summary: Records the total number of cookies found in the legacy Starboard storage record during a migration attempt.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StorageMigration.Duration
histogram.summary: Records the total time taken to migrate data from the legacy Starboard storage record to the new Chromium-based storage.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StorageMigration.FastPathDuration
histogram.summary: Records the total time taken to check for the migration fast path during startup.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StorageMigration.LocalStorageCount
histogram.summary: Records the total number of localStorage entries found in the legacy Starboard storage record during a migration attempt.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StorageMigration.LocalStorageInjectionResult
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of attempting to inject a single localStorage entry into the new Chromium-based storage during migration from legacy Starboard storage.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StorageMigration.Outcome
histogram.summary: Records the final outcome of the storage migration process. Tracks whether the migration took the fast path, skipped due to no data, fully succeeded, or failed during read/injection.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StorageMigration.ReadResult
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of attempting to read and parse the legacy Starboard storage record during migration.

histogram.name: Cobalt.StorageMigration.SentinelWriteResult
histogram.summary: Records the result of writing the migration sentinel file to disk.

histogram.name: Cobalt.WebContentsObserver.FailedNavigation
histogram.summary: For every navigation in the primary main frame, this boolean is recorded to indicate whether the navigation resulted in a network error. This is used to track the navigation success rate. Aborted navigations are not included.

histogram.name: Cobalt.WebContentsObserver.FailedNavigationError
histogram.summary: Records the net error code for every primary main frame navigation failure.

histogram.name: CPU.Total.UsageInPercentage
histogram.summary: The Percentage of total CPU resources utilized for Cobalt over an interval. 100% indicates all available cores are fully utilized. This metric is recorded periodically (default 5 minutes for Android).

histogram.name: HangWatcher.IsThreadHung.BrowserProcess.RendererThread
histogram.summary: Every 10 seconds, a boolean is recorded to this histogram to indicate whether the RendererThread of a Browser process was hung. The thread is hung if the current work unit started running more than 10 seconds ago. This is emitted only in single process mode(when renderer is a thread inside BrowserProcess).

histogram.name: Memory.Browser.AndroidRuntimeRss
histogram.summary: The physical memory (RSS) consumed by the Android/Dalvik runtime environment. This tracks ART image files (.art), Optimized Android Template files (.oat), and internal Dalvik allocator regions (e.g., dalvik-main space). Currently restricted to Android.

histogram.name: Memory.Browser.AshmemJitRss
histogram.summary: The physical memory (RSS) consumed by anonymous shared memory (Ashmem) and the Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation cache. This tracks mappings tagged with /dev/ashmem/ and memfd:jit-cache. Currently restricted to Android.

histogram.name: Memory.Browser.CodeOtherRss
histogram.summary: The physical memory (RSS) consumed by non-Cobalt executable code and read-only data mappings. This is a catch-all for system libraries (.so), GPU drivers (e.g., libGLES_mali.so), the application package (.apk), and compiled Java bytecode (.dex). Excludes the main libchrobalt.so. Currently restricted to Android.

histogram.name: Memory.Browser.FontsRss
histogram.summary: The physical memory (RSS) consumed by system and application font mappings, specifically TrueType (.ttf) and TrueType Collection (.ttc) files. Currently restricted to Android.

histogram.name: Memory.Browser.LibChrobaltPss
histogram.summary: The Proportional Set Size (PSS) of the core libchrobalt.so library. PSS accounts for the fact that some pages of the library may be shared with other processes.

histogram.name: Memory.Browser.LibChrobaltRss
histogram.summary: The physical Resident Set Size (RSS) of the core libchrobalt.so library. This represents the total number of pages from this library currently resident in RAM.

histogram.name: Memory.Browser.MallocRss
histogram.summary: The physical memory (RSS) used by the system allocator. On Android, this typically tracks the scudo allocator and the standard [heap] region.

histogram.name: Memory.Browser.PartitionAllocRss
histogram.summary: The physical memory (RSS) consumed specifically by PartitionAlloc's anonymous mappings, which are used for most of Cobalt's internal object allocations.

histogram.name: Memory.Browser.StacksRss
histogram.summary: The physical memory (RSS) consumed by all thread stacks and Thread-Local Storage (TLS) regions within the process.

histogram.name: Memory.Experimental.Browser2.AndroidGraphicsMemory
histogram.summary: Graphics memory usage (GPU) on Android for cobalt. This data comes from graphics section of dumpsys meminfo.

histogram.name: Memory.Experimental.Browser2.AndroidRuntime
histogram.summary: Accurate RSS for the Android Runtime pillar (ART/Dalvik). This is used for the cumulative CDF breakdown of the total ResidentSet. Currently restricted to Android.

histogram.name: Memory.Experimental.Browser2.AshmemJit
histogram.summary: Accurate RSS for the Ashmem and JIT cache pillar. This is used for the cumulative CDF breakdown of the total ResidentSet. Currently restricted to Android.

histogram.name: Memory.Experimental.Browser2.CodeOther
histogram.summary: Accurate RSS for the CodeOther pillar (system libs, APK, drivers). This is used for the cumulative CDF breakdown of the total ResidentSet. Currently restricted to Android.

histogram.name: Memory.Experimental.Browser2.Fonts
histogram.summary: Accurate RSS for the Fonts pillar (.ttf/.ttc). This is used for the cumulative CDF breakdown of the total ResidentSet. Currently restricted to Android.

histogram.name: Memory.Experimental.Browser2.Stacks
histogram.summary: Accurate RSS for the thread stacks pillar. This is used for the cumulative CDF breakdown of the total ResidentSet.

histogram.name: Memory.Experimental.Renderer.PeakResidentSet.AtHighestPrivateMemoryFootprint
histogram.summary: The peak resident set at the time of the highest private memory footprint.

histogram.name: Memory.Media.AllocatedEncodedBuffer
histogram.summary: Records the memory allocated by media decoder buffer for video and audio.

histogram.name: Memory.Media.EstimatedDecodedBuffer
histogram.summary: Records total estimated memory allocation used for media output buffer by Android MediaCodec.

histogram.name: Memory.Total.PrivateFootprintSwap
histogram.summary: A rough estimate of the private memory footprint that has been swapped out to disk for the Cobalt process. Recorded at regular intervals when memory metrics are emitted.

histogram.name: Memory.Total.VmSize
histogram.summary: The virtual memory size of the Cobalt process. Virtual memory size includes all memory the process can access, including shared libraries, stack, heap, and memory-mapped files. Recorded at regular intervals when memory metrics are emitted.
